title: Freyr's Love
description:
A STORY BEYOND MYTHSControl the Norse Gods in a long mythy adventure. Help Freyr about his love. Find Gerd and bring her to Freyr. Witness skirnir while he gaining gods power.Key Features:Feel the power of Freyr's magic sword.• Throw your sword and wait. 

• Time will slow down and your sword will always come back.
Kill different kinds of creatures.• Draugars

• Skeletons
Call Gods for help.• Call Freyja to restore your health.

• Call Njörd in order to create an earthquake.
 Fight against your enemies with power of the Gods.• Call the gods when you need them and dominate the warzone.

• Use their power against your enemies.
Witness the Ragnarok.• Learn the truth about Ragnarok.

• Witness Ragnarok mysteries through this story.
Gameplay• Control your character left and right.

• Jump above your enemies.

• Dash through your enemies and make them miss.

• Use 3 different kind of attack to kill your enemies.

• Use your heavy attack.
description_short: An adventure beyond myths. Control the gods and witness the story through Skirnir. Kill them all.
